unsourced: The 30 club kits, patch sponsors, owners and ratings for this target already exist in normalized/ (added by the earlier US-leagues wave, commits 1903575/4c01b74); all 30 kit sponsor source URLs were re-opened and resolved (200) on 2026-09-25, except two that block bots: NJ.com (Yankees x Starr Insurance) and Crain's Cleveland (Guardians x Marathon extension), both confirmed via reader-proxy fetches of the full article text.

Yankees x Starr Insurance: the NJ.com article (opened via reader proxy, published 2026-04-22) confirms the Starr Insurance patch on the left sleeve since 21 July 2023 and reports a reported $25m through the 2031 season; the $25m figure is a press report, not a club disclosure, and is not recorded as a deal value.

Guardians x Marathon: Crain's Cleveland Business (opened via reader proxy, published 2026-09-16) reports the jersey-patch partnership extended beyond the 2026 season; the deal record's open-ended 'to' stays null.

The league entry in normalized/leagues.json already exists with clubCount 30 and season 2026; this file proposes status 'partial' plus notes. The 2026-27 season label on the 30 existing MLB kits differs from the calendar-year 2026 league season - left as-is to avoid touching shared files.

MLB's Official International Sponsors page (https://www.mlb.com/international/partners, opened 2026-09-25) lists many regional partners (Japan, Asia-Pacific, Canada, Europe, Latin America); those were not recorded as deals - out of scope for a first pass and each needs its own source check.
Deal start years for the 40 official sponsors are not stated on the official-sponsors page and were left null; the sponsor logos link to partner sites, not announcement releases.
STRAUSS (us.strauss.com, Strauss America workwear) is a different company from the existing 'strauss' sponsor (Strauss GmbH, Germany); a new id 'strauss-america' was created to avoid merging them.
Budweiser is listed as an official sponsor via the Anheuser-Busch module; recorded under the existing sponsorId 'anheuser-busch' with the brand named in the note.

No claims or proposed ratings were added: none of the 40 league-level official sponsors is state-owned or state-linked on the face of the ownership data already in the repo, and the existing patch-sponsor ratings (lvcva serious, kroger concern, rest none) were set in the earlier wave.
